rationale: The candidate is a coherent single mass in all four views and the courtyard carve is legible, so gesture and hierarchy are strong. However, the visible section is dominated by a deep inverted gash/roof-vault condition that reads more like a bridge or carved roof object than a compact neighborhood living building with active ground threshold. The mass also does not convincingly align the public void to the verified access edge in a way that strengthens entry; the access response feels indirect/semantically weak. Because the form is coherent but sectionally over-abstracted, it fails the program fit hard gate for neighborhood living. The open void is good as a spatial idea, but the roof/section relationship is not yet the right programmatic one.
